example_name: Door Opening with Planar Mobile Base
user_request_examples: Create a mobile robot that can open a hinged door
Set up a simulation with a robot navigating through a doorway
Build a mobile manipulator that interacts with articulated objects
Make a robot push or pull a door open
scenario_description: A UR5e arm mounted on a 3-DOF planar mobile base approaches a hinged door, grasps the handle, pulls the door open while coordinating base motion to follow the door arc, then navigates through the doorway. This is one of the most complex manipulation scenarios, combining mobile manipulation, contact-rich interaction, and articulated environment dynamics.

mobile_base.reason: Full planar mobility required to follow door arc and navigate through

robot_arm.mounting: Fixed to arm_mount on mobile base

kinematic_structure.chain: world → world_link → virtual_x → virtual_y → mobile_base → arm_mount → ur5e_base_link → ... → ur5e_tool0
kinematic_structure.virtual_links_purpose: Create serial kinematic chain for 3-DOF planar motion
kinematic_structure.reason: Drake requires serial kinematic trees; virtual links enable planar base

complexity_factors.planar_base_modeling: 3 virtual links to create X-Y-Yaw kinematic chain
complexity_factors.articulated_object: Door has its own DOF; joint state includes door angle
complexity_factors.contact_rich: Must maintain contact with handle while moving
complexity_factors.coordinated_motion: Base must follow circular arc as door opens
complexity_factors.constraint_following: End-effector constrained to door handle trajectory

step1_scene_modeling.door_frame_setup: Static walls and hinge post defining doorway
step1_scene_modeling.door_modeling: Door panel as rigid body with revolute joint to hinge post

phase_2_grasp.constraint: End-effector fixed to handle in world frame (before door moves)

phase_3_pull_open.description: Pull door open while following arc
phase_3_pull_open.base_motion: Follow circular arc (radius ~0.9m, center at hinge)
phase_3_pull_open.arm_motion: Maintain grasp on handle as it moves
phase_3_pull_open.constraint: End-effector follows handle trajectory: r(t) = hinge + R(θ(t)) * handle_offset
phase_3_pull_open.coordination: Base XY position and yaw must track handle arc

phase_4_release.description: Release handle when door is open

phase_5_navigate.collision_avoidance: Stay clear of door and frame

approach_1_position_control.description: Track handle position with IK at each timestep
approach_1_position_control.method: Given door_angle(t), compute handle_pos(t), solve IK for base+arm
approach_1_position_control.cons: May lose contact, doesn't enforce physical constraint

approach_2_closed_loop_constraint.method: Add position constraint between end-effector and handle

planar_base_pattern.reason: Drake requires bodies at both ends of each joint

articulated_environment.door_as_model: Door is a separate model, not static
articulated_environment.door_joint: Revolute joint between door_frame and door
articulated_environment.joint_state: Door angle is part of plant state

contact_modeling.friction: High friction (0.8) on handle for secure grasp

inverse_kinematics_9dof.orientation: Grasp orientation aligned with handle axis

expected_behavior.phase_3: Robot pulls door open: base moves in arc (backward and leftward), door swings 0→90°
expected_behavior.phase_5: Base navigates forward through open doorway
expected_behavior.final_state: Robot beyond door at [2.0, 0.5, 0], door open at 90°

validation_criteria.contact_maintained: End-effector stays on handle during pull (phase 3)
validation_criteria.no_collisions: No base-door, arm-door, or arm-wall collisions
validation_criteria.successful_navigation: Base passes through doorway without collision

ik_fails_9dof.symptom: Cannot find configuration to grasp handle
solutions: Position base closer to door (1.0m instead of 1.5m)
Adjust arm mount height for better reach
Use sequential IK (base first, then arm)

contact_loss.symptom: End-effector slips off handle during pull

base_door_collision.symptom: Mobile base collides with door panel as it opens
solutions: Increase arc radius (move base in larger circle)
Coordinate base motion with door angle

circular_arc_tracking.symptom: Base doesn't follow door handle properly
solutions: Precompute base trajectory: x(t) = hinge_x + r*cos(θ(t)), y(t) = hinge_y + r*sin(θ(t))
Use feedback control to correct tracking errors
Coordinate base yaw with door angle: yaw(t) = θ(t)

extensions.push_door: Robot pushes door instead of pulling
extensions.lever_handle: Handle rotates; robot must turn it first
extensions.vision_guided: Use camera to detect handle pose
extensions.dual_arm: One arm opens door, other carries object through

learning_outcomes.planar_base_modeling: How to model SE(2) mobile bases with virtual links
learning_outcomes.articulated_objects: Simulating doors, drawers, and other movable environment objects
learning_outcomes.coordinated_mobile_manipulation: Coupling base and arm motion for constraint following

code_snippets.planar_base_joints: 3 joints in series: prismatic(X) → prismatic(Y) → revolute(Yaw)
code_snippets.arc_trajectory: x = hinge_x + r*cos(theta), y = hinge_y + r*sin(theta), yaw = theta
